ai.sum: EU leaders are reportedly set to debate assigning a negotiator for Russia at the Dublin summit.

items.title: Parties outline positions during Abu Dhabi talks; significant differences remain - Umerov
items.summary: Rustem Umerov, head of the Foreign Intelligence Service of Ukraine, identified an agreement on a prisoner exchange as the primary outcome of the negotiations held in Abu Dhabi on November 10–11, while noting that significant differences in the parties' positions persist.

ai.sum: Ukrainian intelligence chief Rustem Umerov said Abu Dhabi talks on November 10–11 produced a prisoner exchange deal but significant differences remain.

items.title: EU accuses Russia of systematic deportation, indoctrination of Ukrainian children
items.summary: 'Russia shows no signs that it's ready to seriously negotiate,' says foreign policy chief

ai.sum: The EU accused Russia of systematic deportation and indoctrination of Ukrainian children, saying Moscow shows no readiness to negotiate seriously.

items.title: EU ambassadors agree sanctions on 50 Russian banks as part of new restrictions against Russia – media
items.summary: European Union ambassadors have agreed on new sanctions against Russia, covering 50 Russian banks involved in financing the aggression against Ukraine, reports "European Truth," citing an EU diplomat familiar with the results of the meeting.

ai.sum: EU ambassadors agreed new sanctions covering 50 Russian banks involved in financing the war against Ukraine.

items.title: EU leaders to discuss appointing rep to talks on ending Russia's war against Ukraine, but no agreement expected
items.summary: European Union leaders will discuss the possibility of appointing a single EU representative to participate in negotiations to end Russia's war against Ukraine at an informal summit in Dublin on November 13; however, it is unlikely that an agreement on this issue will be reached in the coming days.

ai.sum: EU leaders will discuss appointing a single EU representative for talks to end Russia's war on Ukraine at a Dublin summit on November 13, with no agreement expected.

items.title: G7 to step up financial support for Ukraine to meet its winter needs – statement
items.summary: The leaders of the Group of Seven (G7) nations have agreed to increase financial and material assistance to Ukraine to support the country through the winter, reaffirming their shared commitment to strengthening its energy security and resilience.

ai.sum: G7 leaders agreed to increase financial and material aid to Ukraine to help it through winter and strengthen energy security.

items.title: Budanov: Abu Dhabi talks difficult, but significant result achieved on prisoner exchange
items.summary: Head of the President's Office of Ukraine Kyrylo Budanov described the negotiations held in Abu Dhabi on November 10-11 as challenging and emphasized that Ukraine's position remains unchanged: the war must be stopped and an effective security architecture must be established.

ai.sum: Ukrainian presidential office head Budanov said Abu Dhabi talks on November 10-11 were difficult but yielded a significant prisoner exchange result.

items.title: EU sets out $3.4B defense budget for 2027, boosts Ukraine spending
items.summary: The new fiscal uplift comes in the wake of Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy telling European leaders last month that “we need at least €70 billion more from you.”

ai.sum: The EU set out a $3.4 billion defence budget for 2027 with increased Ukraine spending, following Zelenskyy's call for at least €70 billion more from Europe.

items.title: SBU, Defence Forces strike Russian port, oil infrastructure in Ust-Luga, Buyan-M missile ship
items.summary: On the night of Wednesday, November 11, the State Security Service of Ukraine (SBU), in coordination with other components of the Defense Forces, struck port, oil refining, and transportation infrastructure in the port of Ust-Luga in Leningrad region, as well as the small missile ship "Buyan-M" "Naro-Fominsk," according to the SBU press service.

ai.sum: Ukraine's SBU and Defence Forces struck the Ust-Luga port, oil infrastructure and the Buyan-M missile ship in Russia's Leningrad region.

items.title: Ireland fears undersea cables face growing threat from ‘malign actors’
items.summary: Home to many US tech multinationals, Ireland raises alarm over Russia's so-called shadow fleet.

ai.sum: Ireland, home to many US tech firms, raised alarm over threats to undersea cables from malign actors, including Russia's shadow fleet.

items.title: Situation in special op zone significantly changed since Anchorage meeting — Shoigu

items.title: Rusya'dan İsrail'e "Gazze'ye insani yardımın ulaştırılması için acilen önlem alma" çağrısı"
items.summary: Rusya Dışişleri Bakanlığı Sözcüsü Mariya Zaharova, İsrail’e Gazze'deki durumun daha da kötüleşmesini önlemek ve insani yardım üzerindeki engelleri kaldırmak için acilen önlemler alma çağrısında bulundu.

ai.sum: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova urged Israel to urgently take steps to ensure humanitarian aid reaches Gaza and to prevent further deterioration.
ai.title_en: Russia calls on Israel to urgently ensure humanitarian aid reaches Gaza

items.title: Russia’s ambassador to US, Alexander Darchiev, dies at 66
items.summary: Moscow announces the veteran diplomat's sudden passing without further details.

items.title: Ukraine counts on Turkey's continued active role in achieving just, lasting peace – FMs meeting
items.summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiha held a meeting with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan, noting the active development of the strategic partnership between the two countries and Turkey's role in efforts to achieve peace.

ai.sum: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Sybiha met Turkish Foreign Minister Fidan, citing Türkiye's role in efforts toward peace and their strategic partnership.

items.title: Defense ministers of Ukraine and Netherlands discuss strengthening air defense
items.summary: The defense ministers of Ukraine and the Netherlands, Yevhen Khmara and Dilan Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, discussed strengthening air defense, specifically, the possibility of transferring Patriot missiles from partners' stockpiles in exchange for future, already-contracted deliveries, the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense press service reported.

ai.sum: Ukrainian and Dutch defence ministers discussed transferring Patriot missiles from partner stocks in exchange for future contracted deliveries.

items.title: Russia’s Omsk under drone alert for seven hours amid Ukrainian attack, governor urges residents to stay indoors
items.summary: Ukraine’s armed forces is carrying out a massive, hours-long drone attack on Omsk.

ai.sum: Omsk was under drone alert for seven hours during a massive Ukrainian drone attack, and the governor urged residents to stay indoors.

items.title: Rada ratifies agreements with EIB to secure EUR 100 mln for social housing construction
items.summary: The Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine has ratified agreements with the European Investment Bank (EIB) to secure an investment grant and a loan for the construction of social housing in Ukraine, according to a press release from the Ministry of Communities, Territories, and Internally Displaced Persons.

ai.sum: Ukraine's parliament ratified European Investment Bank agreements securing EUR 100 million for social housing construction.

items.title: Zelensky arrives in Dublin for European Political Community summit, expects a debrief from Witkoff, Kushner
items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky added that a meeting with U.S. special envoys — Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner — will also take place in Ireland, following the envoys' trip to Russia.

ai.sum: Zelensky arrived in Dublin for the European Political Community summit and will meet US envoys Witkoff and Kushner after their Russia trip.

items.title: UN chief, EU Commission president discuss climate, regional crises on sidelines of COP31
items.summary: Antonio Guterres, Ursula von der Leyen review Middle East, Russia-Ukraine war during Antalya summit

ai.sum: UN Secretary-General Guterres and EU Commission President von der Leyen discussed Middle East and Russia-Ukraine war on the sidelines of the Antalya COP31 summit.

items.title: Ukraine and Czech Republic to expand energy cooperation – memo signed
items.summary: Ukraine and the Czech Republic have signed a Memorandum of Understanding in the energy sector, which provides for deeper cooperation in areas including nuclear energy, oil and gas, hydropower, and the enhancement of energy system resilience, announced Denys Shmyhal, First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Energy of Ukraine.

ai.sum: Ukraine and the Czech Republic signed an energy memorandum covering nuclear, oil and gas, hydropower and grid resilience.

items.title: Zelenskyy and his team arrive in Ireland
items.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has landed in Dublin with his team to participate in the 9th EPC Summit and hold talks with US envoys.

items.title: Armenia loses voting rights in CSTO over debt obligations: what we know

items.title: Hackers target Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform, replace website with anti-Ukrainian messages
items.summary: The hackers replaced the agency's homepage with the word ZELENET, an image of a crossed-out Ukrainian flag, and a link to a Telegram channel. Ukrinform's account on X was also renamed ZELENET, while its biography was changed to include a pro-Russian slogan.

ai.sum: Hackers took over Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform's website and social accounts, replacing content with anti-Ukrainian messages.

items.summary: Member states of the Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO) have stripped Armenia of its voting rights within the organization. items.summary: Between November 1 and 10, Ukraine’s Defense Forces neutralized 3,068 out of 3,519 attack drones, specifically Shahed, Gerbera, and Parodiya models, launched by Russian forces toward Ukrainian territory, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine reported.

items.title: NATO taps Ukraine as red-team in drills to ‘trigger an adaptation cycle’
items.summary: “What we’ve done so far, we took some experience from Ukraine, for example, where we hid some Ukrainian forces and Ukrainian-made USVs, and made them the red team against the blue force of NATO,” Adm. Pierre Vander told Breaking Defense.

items.title: Tens of thousands attend Polish nationalist march days afer shootings
items.summary: Tens of thousands of Polish nationalist sympathisers gathered in Warsaw Wednesday for an annual Independence Day March, just days after a deadly shooting spree in Krakow that shook the country. The event is held each November 11 to commemorate the ending in 1918 of 123 years of partition by Russia, Prussia and Austria. While generally peaceful, some rallies in the pasthave been marred by clashes with police or counter-demonstrators. Philip Turle gives us his take.

ai.sum: Tens of thousands of Polish nationalists marched in Warsaw on Independence Day, days after a deadly shooting spree in Krakow.

items.title: Тысячи школ в Италии, Великобритании и Ирландии получили сообщения с угрозами взрыва
items.summary: Тысячи школ в Италии, Великобритании и Ирландии 11 ноября получили ложные сообщения с угрозами взрыва, рассказало агентство Reuters. Италия. По всей Италии прошла эвакуация школ после того, как около 6,3 тысячи учебных заведений получили письма о минировании, узнали журналисты. Сообщения были подписаны «Михаилом Андроповым, лидером Вилаята Мизогинистана». В них, по данным Reuters, также содержались угрозы нападения на премьер-министра Италии Джорджю Мелони. Она заявила, что…

ai.sum: Thousands of schools in Italy, Britain and Ireland received false bomb-threat messages signed by a purported extremist group, prompting evacuations.
